player_prompt.intro:
I ka soli Sokoban ɲɛ. I ye jɛgɛnɛ ye, i bɛna kɛnɛ kɔrɔbɔw ye minnu bɛ kɛnɛ da la.
        Ni i bɛ kɛnɛ kɔrɔbɔ kɔnɔ, i bɛna kɛnɛ bɔ kɔrɔbɔ la ni i bɛ tɛmɛn i nɔ na.
        I ma se ka kɛnɛ kɔrɔbɔ la dɔkɔnɔnɛ kɔnɔ, i ma se ka kɛnɛ kɔrɔbɔ la bɔ.
        Kɔnɔ bɔ, ɲɛbɛri bɛ wale: 
        - Jɛgɛnɛ (i) bɛ wale 'P' 
        - Dɔkɔnɔnɛ bɛ wale '#' 
        - Kɔrɔbɔw bɛ wale 'X' 
        - Kɔnɔ bɛɛ bɛ wale 'O'
        - Kɔrɔbɔw kɔnɔ bɛ wale '√'
        I bɛ se ka [w] bɔ kɔnɔ, [a] bɔ kɔɲɛ, [s] bɔ kɔɲɛɲɛ, ni [d] bɔ kɔnɔɲɛ.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kɛnɛ bɔɲɛ ma se ka dɔnɛ kɔrɔ. I bɛ se ka [up], [down], [left], [right] wala [w], [a], [s], [d] bɔ.
invalid_move.not_valid_action: O ko in ma kɛ waleɲumandɔn ye.
invalid_move.wall_collision: I tɛ se ka taa kogo dɔ kɔnɔ!
invalid_move.invalid_position: Koli balilen - a tɛ se ka taa o yɔrɔ la.

game_message.pushed_prefix: ka finimugu dɔ ɲɔni tuma min na.

outcome.turn_limit: Kɛnɛ bɔlɔ bɛɛ ma bɛna. I ma bɛna soli.
